label: VERIFIED
extraction: Council skill convenes four voices for ambiguous decisions: in-context Architect, Skeptic subagent, Pragmatist subagent, Critic subagent. For decision-making under ambiguity, not code review or implementation. Workflow: 1) Extract real decision question with constraints and success criteria, 2) Gather minimal necessary context, 3) Form Architect position first (initial position, 3 reasons, main risk), 4) Launch three independent voices in parallel with role-specific prompts (Skeptic challenges framing, Pragmatist optimizes for speed/execution, Critic surfaces downside risk), 5) Synthesize with bias guardrails (don't dismiss external views, include strongest dissent), 6) Present compact verdict with consensus, strongest dissent, premise check, recommendation. Anti-patterns: using for code review, feeding full conversation transcript, hiding disagreement. Persistence only when decision changes durable project truth. Related to santa-method (verification) and architecture-decision-records.
